prompt:

Asset type: reusable empty desktop-companion background, final vertical 1024x1536 image.
Primary request: an intimate autumn cafe with an empty central aisle and visible warm light-oak floor. Windows on the LEFT show soft autumn foliage outside. Put small tables and chairs only along the far LEFT edge, far RIGHT edge, and distant back edge; keep the front-center completely clear for later compositing of a full-body adult person at normalized placement x=0.22, y=0.12, width=0.60, height=0.82. Leave the bottom 10 percent as plausible oak floor for feet.
Subject: empty cafe; absolutely no people.
Style/medium: high-quality photoreal interior photograph, natural wood, glass, fabric and subtle autumn texture; no illustration, CGI, dollhouse effect, or miniature effect.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, chest-level camera, moderate natural perspective, no fisheye, no central furniture or chair occluding the reserved foreground.
Lighting/mood: soft natural daylight from the upper LEFT through the windows, intimate but daytime.
Constraints: no people, no legible text, no logos, no watermark, no baked-in character. This must be a standalone reusable background.

qa.notes: Empty cafe with left windows and autumn foliage, edge seating, and a broad clear oak-floor aisle. A small distant plant touches the left edge of the nominal body zone but does not obstruct the foreground composite placement.
